ModMetaData.name: OmniThread Ultimate
ModMetaData.author: ignxo
ModMetaData.description:
OmniThread Ultimate - Lock-Free Multi-Threaded Engine and Auto-Hz Frame Pacer for RimWorld (1.3 - 1.7).
Features: - Dedicated 12+ Thread Persistent Worker Pool with Atomic Work-Stealing and Pawn/Thing LPT Interleaving. - Auto-Hz Dynamic Frame Pacing: Automatically detects monitor refresh rate (60Hz - 240Hz) to eliminate camera micro-stutters while maximizing TPS. - Lock-Free [ThreadStatic] RegionTraverser BFS, ClosestThingReachable pools, and Harmony IL Transpilers. - Atomic MainThreadSyncQueue for deterministic, race-free Unity Engine / Map / Sound / Mote execution. - 100% Save-Game Safe: Can be added or removed mid-playthrough at any time without affecting save files. - Built-in Compatibility and Auto-Guard for 60+ popular mods (RocketMan, CAI-5000 / CombatAI, Combat Extended, Vehicle Framework, Vanilla Expanded Framework, Zoology, RunAndGun, Simple Sidearms, Pick Up And Haul, CommonSense, Hospitality, Dubs Bad Hygiene, Performance Optimizer) and RimPy / RimSort auto-sorting. - Press F11 in-game to toggle the real-time multi-threading telemetry overlay.
